newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dollar seen drifting higher vs yen in Asia.
newsitem.headline: Dollar seen drifting higher vs yen in Asia.

text.p: The dollar is expected to edge higher during Asian trading time on Friday due to pre-weekend short-covering, which is likely to intensify as worries about a rise in Japanese interest rates have waned, dealers said.

"As there are short dollar positions yet to be covered, the dollar may be well-bid. Worries about rises in Japanese interest rates have eased due to weaker-than-expected industrial production data," said a city bank trader.
Japan's April industrial output released on Thursday fell 0.4 percent month-on-month. Economists polled by Reuters had predicted a rise of 0.3 percent to 1.5 percent.
